headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 6 studies yielded an effect size of 1.56 (95% CI: 0.98–2.47), indicating no statistically significant association between calcium and aggressive prostate cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential positive relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 76.62%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
